propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as codebase-verifiable or operator-attested based on where completion evidence can truthfully be verified, with criterion-specific evidence for each classification.

Criteria with completion evidence inherently outside the repository must use the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag; untagged or malformed tags incorrectly default to codebase-verifiable and should produce findings naming the exact required syntax.
Criteria that are codebase-verifiable but carry the [operator-attested] tag should produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Criteria bundling both repository proof and outside-world proof must not be silently assigned one evidence kind; review must require splitting into independently certifiable criteria.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings must participate in normal validity × impact blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory and fail-open.

Pinned multi-sample evaluation over frozen corpus including A1, 115b/8c4f cases, malformed tags, over-tagged code, and mixed-evidence items must achieve 100% precision on genuine-external negatives, 100% recall on named fixtures, and ≥0.90 macro precision/recall across full corpus.
